record.question: The science which aims to improve the genetic endowment of human population is known as:
record.explanation: Answer A: Eugenics. Eugenics is the historical term for attempting to alter the genetic composition of human populations; the term is now ethically fraught and associated with coercive practices. Source/context note: Historical definition only; eugenics is not an accepted public-health goal. Reference: https://www.genome.gov/about-genomics/fact-sheets/Eugenics-and-Scientific-Racism. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
